<a id="page-components"></a>
# Components

Calling a component, and writing one: its head (`component`, `param`, `event`, `slot`, `preview` lines) and its
tree. Open it when a UI reuses a part, or you write a component for a site or a design system.

<a id="components-calling-one"></a>
## Calling one

A component is written like any word: `Name "text" @name key=value onEvent={…}`. Its strings fill its text
parameters in order; `@name` is the variable it keeps its value in (its `value`, else its first variable
parameter), `key=@name` each further variable parameter (`direction=@dir`); its events are `on…` keys by their own
names. `onTap` on a component whose press event has another name (`onPressed`, `onClick`) is that event, as
`onChange` is its `onChanged` and `onSubmit` its `onSubmitted`; any other `on…` it has no event of is what that
name does on any line: `TaskCard … onTap={open card}` on a card whose only event is `onMenu` opens the card on a
press anywhere on it (its menu button keeps its own press).

A site's own components are known to the expander with nothing more said: a file in a site's folder (a
`site.json` beside it or above it, as `site.json` or `site/site.json`) calls every component written in the
notation in its `components/*.txt` and every expanded one `site.json` lists, reads the site's variables by name
(a component that writes one does not make its own) and takes the site's theme. `tool/notation/notation.sh expand
<site folder>` expands the whole site, each component after the ones it calls, then every page. A component named
like a word of the notation (`Footer`, `Sidebar`, `Card`) is not called where that word is read: the expander says
so; write `Footer type=Footer`, or give the component a name of its own (`SiteFooter`). A `components/<Name>.txt`
whose first line is `define Name …` (or `primitive`) is the site's definitions instead: every page and component
reads them, as a page reads a `define` after its last line; a file that is neither fails the expand, `--open` too,
saying what to write. A word the notation already has is the notation's, whoever defines it: a page's or a site's
`define`, `primitive` or component named like a core word, a page word or a name the notation reads as one of its
own (`Card`, `Rail`, `Shortcut`) is not used, and the expand says so at the definition. Every
expand saves the site's vocabulary record (`vocabulary.json` and `VOCABULARY.md` in the site's folder) and says
each word that stood in as a placeholder.

<a id="components-writing-one"></a>
## Writing one

A component's document is its head, then its tree (no canvas):

```notation
component StatusPill "A short status, colored by its tone."
  param label="Active" required doc="What it says."
  param tone:neutral|success|danger="neutral"
  event onChanged:String doc="The new label."
  slot trailing
  preview "Default" 120x28 label="Active" tone="success"
Row#pill gap=4
  Text#pillLabel "Active"
```

- `param name[:Type]=default`: a parameter, its type in Flutter's names (`String`, `bool`, `double`, `int`, `Map`
  or `dynamic` for a record or anything, `List<…>` (`List<Map>`: records), `ValueNotifier<…>` for a variable parameter, an enum's values joined by `|`) where the default does
  not say it; `required` and `doc="…"` after it.
- `event name:Type`: an event and the type of its payload; `emit name value` sends it (`emit onRemove props.label`, `emit onNavigate "{result}"`: a text with values in it reads them).
- `slot name`: a place the caller fills with one line (several actions in a slot: a Row around them).
- `preview "Name" 340x66 key=value …`: a preview, its size and the call's values.

A component's `key`, `every` and `on load` lines, after its tree, are the screen's that shows it: each page that
calls it takes them once, however many calls (a sidebar's `key alt+1 onPress={go members}` written once in the
sidebar, not on every page). A page's own line for the same key is the page's. They run on that screen, so they
read and set the page's and the site's variables, not the component's own: the expander says so when one does.

A word defined in the text (`define`, [design-systems.md](design-systems.md)) is written out where it is used: it
is not a component of the document.

<a id="components-words"></a>
## Words

<a id="node-slot"></a>
### `Slot` (`slot`)

Inside a component: where the call's children (or one named slot) go; its own children show when the call passes none.

- Written `Slot`. Level 3 (Design systems).
- Takes no quoted string.
- The lines under it are its children.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | `"children"` | 3 | children (the call's children) or a declared slot name. |

<a id="node-external"></a>
### `External` (`external`)

A widget built by the app.

- Written `External`. Level 4 (Full vocabulary).
- Takes no quoted string.
- Takes no lines under it.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `builderId` | text | `""` | 4 | The id of the app's builder. |

<a id="node-placeholder"></a>
### `Placeholder` (`placeholder`)

An empty slot (`SizedBox`).

- Written `Placeholder`. Level 0 (Core).
- `Placeholder "…"` sets `props.text`; it takes one quoted string (a second is said).
- Takes no lines under it.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | text | `""` | 0 |  |
| `leadingAsset` | text | `""` | 0 |  |

<a id="node-singlePlaceholder"></a>
### `SinglePlaceholder` (`singlePlaceholder`)

A one-child slot.

- Written `SinglePlaceholder`. Level 0 (Core).
- Takes no quoted string.
- The lines under it are its children.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `allowedTypes` | list of text | `[]` | 0 | The node types the slot accepts (empty: any) and refuses. |
| `deniedTypes` | list of text | `[]` | 0 |  |
| `maxAllowedSize` | [Size](values.md#type-Size) |  | 0 | The largest child it accepts, `[width, height]`. |
| `ephemeral` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | Its child is temporary (not kept when the slot is filled again). |

## Events and actions

Each is on [events.md](events.md), with its fields.

- Events: [`onEvent`](events.md#trigger-event).
- Actions: [`componentEvent`](events.md#action-componentEvent).

## Examples

The JSON reference's examples for this page, printed in the notation. A `{…}` at the end of a line is what the notation has no words for yet ([_tails.md](_tails.md)).

<a id="components-example-site-components-header-json"></a>
### site/components/Header.json

From [`site/components/Header.json`](../components.md).

```notation
component Header "The site's top bar: the name (home) and an About link (a modal)."
  param savedCount:int=0
Row#bar gap=16 pad=[20,0,20,0] w={"fill":390} h=56 fill=paper border-bottom=line crossAxisAlignment=null
  Text#brand "Waymark" weight=700 from=body w={"hug":120} h={"hug":22} onTap={go home}
  Text#count "{props.savedCount} saved" color=muted from=body right w={"fill":120} h={"hug":22}
  Text#about "About" w={"hug":120} h={"hug":22} style=link onTap={openModal to=about presentation=dialog}
```

<a id="components-example-site-pages-home-json"></a>
### site/pages/home.json

From [`site/pages/home.json`](../components.md).

```notation components
canvas "Home" path="/" h=844 fill=paper
Column#page scroll w={"fill":390} h={"fill":844} crossAxisAlignment=null
  Header#header type=Header w={"fill":390} h=56 savedCount={length(saved)}
  Column#main gap=16 pad=20 w={"fill":390} h={"hug":300} maxWidth=960
    Text#title "Trips by rail" w={"fill":350} h={"hug":34} style=title
    ListView#tripList w={"fill":350} h={"hug":200} scrollable=false gap=12
      each item in trips
        Row#tripCard between pad=[16,0,16,0] w={"fill":350} h=64 fill=#FFFFFFFF border=line radius=12 crossAxisAlignment=null onTap={navigate to=trip params={"id":"${item.id}"}}
          Text#tripName "{item.name}" weight=600 from=body w={"hug":200} h={"hug":22}
          Text#tripDays "{item.days} days" color=muted from=body w={"hug":60} h={"hug":22}
  Footer#footer type=Footer w={"fill":390} h=64
on load={setVariable variable=saved value={coalesce(storage.saved, [])}}
Canvas#about "About" w=320 h=180 decoration.radius=16
  Column#aboutBody gap=16 pad=24 w={"fill":320} h={"fill":180}
    Text#aboutText "Itineraries for travelling slowly by train." w={"fill":272} h={"hug":44} style=body
    Button#aboutClose "Close" w=120 h=40 onTap={close}
```

<a id="components-example-site-pages-trip-json"></a>
### site/pages/trip.json

From [`site/pages/trip.json`](../components.md).

```notation components
state trip:map={coalesce(find(trips, 'id', route.id), first(trips))}
state isSaved:boolean={contains(saved, trip.id)}
canvas "Trip" path="/trip" h=844 fill=paper
Column#page scroll w={"fill":390} h={"fill":844} crossAxisAlignment=null
  Header#header type=Header w={"fill":390} h=56 savedCount={length(saved)}
  Column#main gap=16 pad=20 w={"fill":390} h={"hug":400} maxWidth=960
    Text#back "Back" w={"hug":120} h={"hug":22} style=link onTap={navigate mode=pop}
    Text#title "{trip.name}" w={"fill":350} h={"hug":34} style=title
    Button.outline#save "Save trip" w=160 h=40 label={isSaved ? 'Saved' : 'Save trip'} onTap={if condition={"left":"${isSaved}","op":"isTrue"} then={setVariable variable=saved op=remove value={trip.id}} else={setVariable variable=saved op=add value={trip.id}}; setStorage key=saved valueType=list value={saved}; toast "{isSaved ? 'Saved' : 'Removed'}"}
    Text#packTitle "Packing list" weight=700 from=body w={"hug":120} h={"hug":22}
    ListView#packList w={"fill":350} h={"hug":120} scrollable=false gap=8
      each item in trip.packing
        Row#packRow gap=12 w={"fill":350} h=32 crossAxisAlignment=null onTap={contains(coalesce(get(storage.packed, route.id), []), item) ? setStorage key="packed.{route.id}" valueType=list op=remove value={item} : setStorage key="packed.{route.id}" valueType=list op=add value={item}}
          box#packBox w=20 h=20 fills=[{"color":"#FFFFFFFF"}] fill={contains(coalesce(get(storage.packed, route.id), []), item) ? '#FF2F6B4F' : '#FFFFFFFF'} border=accent strokeWidth=2 radius=4
          Text#packName "{item}" w={"hug":200} h={"hug":22} style=body
  Footer#footer type=Footer w={"fill":390} h=64
```

<a id="components-example-components-md-schema-id"></a>
### components.md: schema, id

From [components.md](../components.md) (the block at line 13 of its template, pages/components.md).

```notation
component Chip "A label with a remove button." children=list
  param label="Chip" required
  param selected:ValueNotifier<bool>=""
  event onRemove:String
  slot leading
  preview "Selected" 240x48 label="Design" selected=true
state hovered=false
Row#chip gap=6 pad=[12,0,8,0] w={"hug":120} h=36 fills=[{"color":"#FFE8EAF6"}] fill={props.selected ? '#FF3F51B5' : '#FFE8EAF6'} radius=18 crossAxisAlignment=null onTap={setVariable variable=props.selected op=toggle}
  Slot#lead w=null h=null name=leading
  Text#text "{props.label}" size=14 props.style.color=#FF1A237E w={"hug":60} h={"hug":20} color={props.selected ? '#FFFFFFFF' : '#FF1A237E'}
  Slot#extra w=null h=null
  Icon#remove "close" w=20 h=20 color=#FF5C6BC0 onTap={emit onRemove props.label}
```

<a id="components-example-site-site-json"></a>
### site/site.json

From [`site/site.json`](../components.md). It is a site's manifest (`site.json`), not a page. It is written as JSON:

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "pages": [
    "pages/home.json",
    "pages/trip.json"
  ],
  "components": [
    "components/Header.json",
    "components/Footer.json"
  ],
  "theme": {
    "colors": {
      "ink": "#FF1B1B1B",
      "paper": "#FFFAF7F2",
      "accent": "#FF2F6B4F",
      "muted": "#FF6B7280",
      "line": "#FFE5E1D8"
    },
    "textStyles": {
      "body": {
        "fontSize": 15,
        "height": 1.4,
        "color": "ink"
      },
      "title": {
        "from": "body",
        "fontSize": 28,
        "fontWeight": 700,
        "height": 1.2
      },
      "link": {
        "from": "body",
        "fontWeight": 600,
        "color": "accent"
      }
    }
  },
  "variables": [
    {
      "name": "trips",
      "type": "list",
      "value": [
        {
          "id": "alps",
          "name": "The Alpine Arc",
          "days": 7,
          "packing": [
            "Rail pass",
            "Rain shell",
            "Walking boots"
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "coast",
          "name": "Coast to Coast",
          "days": 5,
          "packing": [
            "Swimwear",
            "Sun hat"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "saved",
      "type": "list",
      "value": []
    }
  ]
}
```
